dedupe_keys.name: seismic assessment of corroded reinforced concrete structures an experimental and prediction database

description: Seismic Assessment of Corroded Reinforced Concrete Structures - An experimental and prediction database is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Lucas Hogan, University of Auckland (aucklanduni.ac.nz). In the lack of guidance on how to assess the residual capacity of corroded reinforced concrete (RC) structures, the study aims to publish a database of experimental results on the seismic performance of corroded RC structures, and the predicted results from the authors study. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-0mvh-b005. Keywords: corrosion, reinforced concrete, seismic assessment, residual capacity, buildings. Published 2020-03-31. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
